complete_calls.dependency: ChunkBuildPendingJob.Handle writes GrassRecords, FloatingRecords, KelpRecords, TerrainHoles, ThreatEchoFlags, and ArtificialStructures.
complete_calls.consumer_after_completion: BuildChunkPayloadFromJob counts valid records, writes chunk pool slices, caches abyssal navigation and mega-wreck payloads, then marks active buffers dirty.

complete_calls.dependency: ThreatPropagationPendingJob.Handle is the voxel job fence dependent on ThreatPropagationJob.
complete_calls.consumer_after_completion: Threat grid, compressed threat grid, threat echo, and threat voxel outputs copy into GlobalDataVault; threat hotspot and residency invalidation then run.

complete_calls.dependency: FlowFieldPendingJob.Handle writes FlowOutput from threat, density, attractor, and nav-support snapshots.
complete_calls.consumer_after_completion: FlowOutput copies into GlobalDataVault and updates ecosystem flow-field center/time metadata.

complete_calls.dependency: ThermalGridPendingJob.Handle is the flow-volume job fence dependent on BuildAbyssalThermalGridJob.
complete_calls.consumer_after_completion: Thermal and flow-volume outputs copy into GlobalDataVault; biolume surge detection compares previous/current flow snapshots.

phase_plan.schedule_phase: SlowTick schedules chunk, threat, flow, and thermal jobs only when no same-lane job is in flight.
phase_plan.completion_phase: LateFrameTick executes dispatcher-owned VISUAL_SYNC/late-frame barrier and attempts non-forced completion only after IsCompleted; OnDisable/OnDestroy/origin shift use forced teardown.
phase_plan.race_guard: If a job is not complete, completion methods return without publishing or releasing TempJob/native payloads. Schedulers check scheduled flags and fail closed.
